svg.title: Steward Quill, Keeper of the Cisterns
svg.desc: A bust portrait. A middle-aged clerk-monk in a damp grey robe with darker water-stained lower areas, seated behind a low ironwood desk that crosses the bottom of the frame. Hair receding, ink-stained fingers, eyes downcast on the open ledger in front of him whose pages are lined with the names of waiting petitioners and bear a single red wax seal. His right hand holds a small brass wax-stamp raised above the ledger. A brass ticket-dispenser hangs on a leather cord at his belt. Three faint silhouettes recede diagonally into the upper-left background — the line of petitioners trailing into the dark. A nameplate at the foot reads STEWARD QUILL — Keeper of the Cisterns.
